meta.title: Direction of the country
meta.question: Are things in Poland going in the right direction?
meta.measure: Average view of the country's direction, from 0 (wrong direction) to 10 (right direction)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on whether things in Poland are going in the right or the wrong direction, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question. The Eurobarometer's version of the question reads about a point above CBOS and the other surveys under the 2007-15 government, about half a point below under PiS-led governments, and about two points above CBOS and PGSW 2025 since December 2023. Its coding is not reversed and the cause is not established, so its readings are treated as three questions, one for each kind of government, each with its own level; the line since 2024 therefore follows CBOS and PGSW 2025, not the Eurobarometer's level.

items.wording: Generally speaking, is the situation in our country going in a good or a bad direction?
items.notes: CBOS, 1990-03 to 2017-12, 326 surveys: monthly 1993-2017 (11 in 1994), 8 in 1990, 11 in 1991, 8 in 1992; not in 1990-01/02 or 1990-12. Labels in 2006-02 to 2006-06 are truncated after 'w dobrym', hence the short regex.

items.wording: In general, do you feel things in our country are going in the right or the wrong direction?
Are the changes in Poland heading in the right direction? (definitely yes ... definitely no)
items.notes: POLPAN 1993 only, asked in one questionnaire version (about half the 1993 sample: 1,162 not asked). Asks whether the CHANGES in Poland are heading in the right direction.

items.wording: As above, on a 7-point scale (-3 very bad ... +3 very good direction)
items.notes: CBOS 1998-06 to 1998-12, 6 surveys: a 7-point version asked later in the same interviews as the binary question.

items.wording: Are the systemic changes in Poland going in the right or the wrong direction? (PGSW 2000)
items.notes: PGSW 2000 (chang013): direction of the systemic changes.

items.wording: Are things in Poland going in the right or the wrong direction?
Overall, are you satisfied or dissatisfied with the way things are going in our country today?
items.notes: Pew, Polish readings 2002, 2005, 2007, 2008, 2009 (spring and autumn), 2010-2014, 2016, 2019 (14); not asked in Poland 2015, 2017, 2018. Satisfaction with the way things are going in the country, Pew's direction measure.

items.wording: At the present time, are things in (our country) going in the right or the wrong direction? (neither, spontaneous = 5)
items.notes: Eurobarometer direction question under the PiS-led governments (2 readings to November 2007 and 31 readings of 2015-23, sharing one level and one slope): it reads about 0.4 points below CBOS. A question of its own because the Eurobarometer's gap from CBOS follows the government.

items.wording: At the present time, are things in (our country) going in the right or the wrong direction? (neither, spontaneous = 5)
items.notes: Eurobarometer direction question under the PO-PSL government of 2007-15 (22 readings): it reads about 1 point above CBOS. A question of its own because the Eurobarometer's gap from CBOS follows the government.

items.wording: Things in (our country) are going in the right / wrong direction (neither, spontaneous = 5)
Generally speaking, is the situation in our country going in a good or a bad direction?
items.notes: CBOS's mixed-mode surveys (CAPI, CATI or CAWI, the respondent's choice) from APiW 359 (May-June 2020), so a question of its own.

items.wording: Generally speaking, are things in Poland going in a good or a bad direction? (SWPS omnibus 2020)
At the present time, are things in (our country) going in the right or the wrong direction? (neither, spontaneous = 5)
items.notes: Eurobarometer direction question under the Tusk government from December 2023 (12 readings): it reads about 2.3 points above CBOS and about 3 points above PGSW 2025, and does not follow CBOS from wave to wave in this period. Its coding is not reversed; the share answering neither (4.5%) and the sample's age, education and sex were checked, and the cause is not established. A question of its own, so its level does not set the line.
